name: Sticky Notes
author: John Reid
description: Quick sticky notes from the Omarchy bar, stored as plain Markdown files — optionally inside an Obsidian vault

barWidget.description: Create, edit, and delete Markdown sticky notes from a bar popup

schema.label: Notes folder
schema.description: Where notes are stored when no Obsidian vault is set. Each note is one Markdown file.

schema.label: Obsidian vault
schema.description: Path to an Obsidian vault root (the folder containing .obsidian). When set, notes live in the vault folder below and can be opened in Obsidian.

schema.label: Folder inside vault
schema.description: Sub-folder of the vault that holds sticky notes. Empty uses the vault root.

schema.label: Show note count
schema.description: Show how many notes exist next to the bar icon.
